name: scramjet
description: ESM stream framework built on Scramjet Core for Node.js.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
scripts.test:node: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.js test/recovery/*.test.js
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --include="dist/**/*.js" --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --reports-dir=coverage node --test test/*.test.js test/recovery/*.test.js
scripts.lint: biome check --diagnostic-level=error --assist-enabled=false src scripts test package.json

author: Scramjet <opensource@scramjet.org>
